create_gcc_env: create a GccEnv instance with a custom gcc_bin path and benchmark URI for reinforcement learning
reset_gcc_env_benchmark: reset the GccEnv with a new benchmark, action space, or observation space configuration
get_gcc_spec: get the GccSpec description of the compiler specification including available options and flags
get_asm_and_obj_observations: get the assembly code, object code, their sizes, and hashes from the GccEnv observation
set_gcc_compiler_choices: set the current compiler flag choices as a list of ints matching gcc_spec options
